question: For each artefact 1-5, which public deposits independent of the manuscript's current instance could replicate it?
scope: metadata and file listings only; no data file downloaded in this phase

retrieval.pool_1: reuse results/pride_coincidence_candidates_2026-09-19.csv accessions (retrieved 2026-09-19 with 32 cysteine keywords); their full records are re-fetched from the same search endpoint by accession keyword
retrieval.pool_4_linked: for every topic-coherent project: accessions matching PXD\d{6} in its description or protocols, fetched and classified
retrieval.store_echo: every search call's URL, returned count and first accessions are stored (project notes 9.55 lesson: endpoints rewrite queries)

regex.COMPANION: total proteome|global proteome|whole proteome|proteome profiling|protein abundance|unenriched|input proteome|non-?enriched|total protein (level|abundance)|proteome[- ]wide quantif|input (sample|fraction)

must.M1_public: returned by the public search endpoint
must.M3_modification_stated: CYS_MOD (or PHOSPHO for the artefact-1 orthogonal-protease profile only) matches the text fields
must.M4_result_files: >= 1 non-raw file (table or archive) in projectFileNames

A1_cleavage.core: M1-M5 and (a site-table file, or a search-output archive, or a table file)
A1_cleavage.orthogonal_level: HIGH if any NONTRYPTIC protease is named in the sample protocol; MEDIUM if LysC is named and neither trypsin nor a NONTRYPTIC protease; LOW if trypsin (with or without LysC); UNSTATED otherwise
A1_cleavage.why: the direct control the manuscript lacks is a non-tryptic digest; phosphorylation is admitted here as a different modification (basophilic kinase motifs confound it, stated as a limit)

A2_multicys.core: CYS_MOD, a peptide-level table file, and no site-table file
A2_multicys.pending: CYS_MOD with only archives (contents unknown until listed)
A2_multicys.why: the artefact exists only where sites are inferred from peptides

A3_abundance.core: CYS_MOD and ENRICH, and a companion quantification: COMPANION matches the text fields, or a linked deposit (pool_4 or a shared reference string) that does not match ENRICH
A3_abundance.why: protein-level contrasts need total-proteome abundance from the same samples

A4_overlap.core: CYS_MOD and ENRICH, and (a site-table file and a peptide-table file) -> CANDIDATE; a search-output archive only -> PENDING_FILE_INSPECTION
A4_overlap.bonus: BLOCK_ARM matches (a blocking arm or unenriched aliquot makes the observed negative class available)

A5_search_space.why: re-searching with both +32 candidates needs the spectra

independence: a candidate is INDEPENDENT of an artefact's existing instances if its accession differs from all of them, it shares no lab-PI last name with them (read from their own metadata at run time), and none of their DOIs occurs in its references or text

verdicts.CANDIDATE_STRONG: profile core met, independent, and (species differs from every existing instance OR modification family differs); for A1 additionally orthogonal_level HIGH
verdicts.PENDING_FILE_INSPECTION: musts met, profile core undecidable from metadata (archive contents); independent
verdicts.NOT_INDEPENDENT: profile core met or pending, but not independent
verdicts.NOT_SUITABLE: a must or the profile core fails (reason recorded)

ranking_for_download_proposal: for A1: orthogonal HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW
smaller required download (bytes, from the files endpoint)

files_needed.A3_abundance: non-raw tables/archives of the deposit and its companion

download_proposal.note: sizes are read from the files endpoint for shortlisted projects only; nothing is downloaded

PC_retrieval.rule: each must be in the topic-coherent pool; recall reported; any family whose known positive is missed is reported as 'candidate only'

PC_linking_A3.rule: the linking step must connect them; if it does not, A3 companion detection is reported as recall 0 of 1 and every A3 NOT_SUITABLE caused only by 'no companion' becomes PENDING_FILE_INSPECTION

controls.NC_topic: every project admitted by CYS_MOD must contain a CYS_MOD match in its own text; admitted-by-keyword projects failing it are dropped and counted
controls.NC_fuzzy_search: the fraction of pool_2 search hits that fail the protease regex is reported (PRIDE search is fuzzy: 'GluC' returned a glucocorticoid study on 2026-09-22)
controls.recall_undefined: no known multi-protease CYSTEINE deposit exists in this tree, so recall for the A1 orthogonal family is undefined; an empty result there must be written 'not found by this search', never 'none exist'
